title: Occupancy and Residency Certification — How the Number of a Borrower's In-Care Check-In Is Figured
content:
## Formal statement

Under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product, the number of a check-in the absent primary borrower confirms in person while still in care is the **numbering basis** plus the **scheduled contacts** that fell due since the **count-from date**. The scheduled contacts are the calendar days from the count-from date to the handling date, less the late-contact grace and less the settling period, divided by the call-in interval with any fraction dropped, and never fewer than one; that floor applies to the scheduled contacts before they are added to the numbering basis.

Under the standard rule the numbering basis is the count of check-ins recorded on the profile, the count-from date is the profile's absence start date, the call-in interval is the plan's interval between contacts during a health-care absence (90 calendar days under every plan), and the late-contact grace and the settling period are each zero days.

## Definitions

- **Facility letter** — an accepted supporting document on file about the primary borrower, received less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, on a plan whose supporting document setting is none.
- **Borrower's admission date** — the date stated on the accepted health-care absence notice on file for the primary borrower received most recently, with the date that notice was received; where none is on file, the profile's absence start date stands in for both, and where the profile carries no absence start date the handling date stands in for that.
- **Latest recorded check-in** — the check-in on the profile with the latest date, with the supporting document it cites, if any.
- **Highest recorded number** — the highest check-in number on the profile, zero where none is recorded.
- **Monitored loan** — the HECM loan the profile monitors, where it monitors one.
- Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month. Where two records share the date a reading is ordered by, the one entered first is read.

## Input – judgement – output (hypothetical, standard terms)

| Input | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| one check-in recorded; handling date a little more than two call-in intervals after the absence start date | two whole intervals; at least one | the count of check-ins recorded plus 2 scheduled contacts |
| no check-in recorded; handling date less than one interval after the absence start date | zero whole intervals, raised to the floor of one | the count recorded (none) plus 1 scheduled contact |
